name: Cup of Brooklyn
note: OpenStreetMap said "Mo-Th 08:00-16:00; Fr 08:00-17:00; Sa-Su 09:00-05:00"; the shop's own source wins. Read: 1071 Gates Ave, Brooklyn NY 11221 / Hours / Mon–Thu 8–4 / Fri 8-5 / Sat 9–5 / Sun 9–5 Extra fetch (bundle lines cut off after "Hours"). No AM/PM on page; café, so 8–4 read as 08:00-16:00. Single location. OSM "Sa-Su 09:00-05:00" is a typo for 17:00.
